The demo page's NLP engine: a JavaScript port of the modules above.

1/*
2 * Marathi NLP engine for the demo page -- a JavaScript port of the Python
3 * reference implementations, run in the browser on whatever text is pasted.
4 *
5 *   I  analyse / stem         src/morph.py
6 *   C  BM25                   src/retrieve.py
7 *   E  TextRank + MMR         src/summarize.py
8 *   D  topic student          src/lite.py  (imitates marathi-topic-all-doc)
9 *   F  sentiment student      src/lite.py  (imitates marathi-sentiment-md)
10 *   G  entity tagger student  src/lite.py  (imitates marathi-ner)
11 *
12 * build_demo_page.py inlines this file into the page, and verify_demo.py
13 * loads this same file in Node and checks it against the Python modules, so
14 * what is checked is exactly what ships.
15 */
16function makeEngine(DATA) {
17  "use strict";
18  const M = DATA.morph;
19
20  /* ============ I: morphological analyser (src/morph.py) ============ */
21  const MARKS = new Set(Array.from(M.marks));
22  const FINAL = new Set(Array.from(M.finalMatras));
23  const STOP = new Set(M.stopwords);
24  const byLen = t => t.slice().sort((a, b) => b[0].length - a[0].length);
25  const LAYERS = [byLen(M.clitics), byLen(M.postpositions), byLen(M.verb), byLen(M.case)];
26  const aksh = s => { let n = 0; for (const c of s) if (!MARKS.has(c)) n++; return n; };
27
28  function restore(s) {
29    while (s.endsWith(M.virama)) s = s.slice(0, -1);
30    if (s && FINAL.has(s[s.length - 1]) && aksh(s) >= M.minStem) s = s.slice(0, -1);
31    return s;
32  }
33  function strip1(w) {
34    for (const table of LAYERS) for (const [suf, feat, repl] of table) {
35      if (!w.endsWith(suf)) continue;
36      const c = w.slice(0, w.length - suf.length) + repl;
37      if (aksh(c) >= M.minStem) return [c, suf, feat];
38    }
39    return null;
40  }
41  const cache = new Map();
42  function analyse(word) {
43    if (cache.has(word)) return cache.get(word);
44    let w = word.normalize("NFC"), res;
45    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(M.exceptions, word)) {
46      res = { root: M.exceptions[word], features: [], stripped: [] };
47    } else {
48      const features = [], stripped = [];
49      for (let i = 0; i < M.maxStrips; i++) {
50        const h = strip1(w); if (!h) break;
51        w = h[0]; stripped.push(h[1]); features.push(h[2]);
52      }
53      res = { root: restore(w), features, stripped };
54    }
55    cache.set(word, res);
56    return res;
57  }
58  const stem = w => analyse(w).root;
59  const tokenize = t => (t || "").match(/[\u0900-\u097F]+|[A-Za-z]+|\d+/g) || [];
60  const isAscii = t => /^[\x00-\x7F]+$/.test(t);
61  function normTokens(text, useMorph = true) {
62    const out = [];
63    for (const tok of tokenize(text)) {
64      if (STOP.has(tok)) continue;
65      const t = useMorph ? stem(tok) : tok;
66      if (STOP.has(t)) continue;
67      if (aksh(t) >= M.minStem || isAscii(t)) out.push(t);
68    }
69    return out;
70  }
71  function sentTokenize(text) {
72    return (text || "").trim().split(/(?<=[।.!?])\s+/)
73      .map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
74  }
75
76  /* ============ C: BM25 (src/retrieve.py) ============ */
77  const K1 = 1.5, B = 0.75;
78  function buildIndex(texts, useMorph) {
79    const postings = new Map(), len = [];
80    texts.forEach((txt, i) => {
81      const toks = normTokens(txt, useMorph); len.push(toks.length);
82      const tf = new Map();
83      for (const t of toks) tf.set(t, (tf.get(t) || 0) + 1);
84      for (const [t, f] of tf) {
85        if (!postings.has(t)) postings.set(t, []);
86        postings.get(t).push([i, f]);
87      }
88    });
89    const avg = len.length ? len.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / len.length : 0;
90    return { postings, len, avg, n: texts.length, useMorph };
91  }
92  function search(idx, q, topK) {
93    const sc = new Float64Array(idx.n);
94    for (const term of normTokens(q, idx.useMorph)) {
95      const p = idx.postings.get(term); if (!p) continue;
96      const idf = Math.max(Math.log((idx.n - p.length + 0.5) / (p.length + 0.5) + 1), 0);
97      for (const [d, f] of p) {
98        const dn = f + K1 * (1 - B + B * idx.len[d] / Math.max(idx.avg, 1e-9));
99        sc[d] += idf * (f * (K1 + 1)) / Math.max(dn, 1e-9);
100      }
101    }
102    const hits = [];
103    for (let i = 0; i < idx.n; i++) if (sc[i] > 0) hits.push([i, sc[i]]);
104    hits.sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
105    return topK ? hits.slice(0, topK) : hits;
106  }
107
108  /* ============ E: TextRank + MMR (src/summarize.py) ============ */
109  const DAMPING = 0.85, MAX_ITER = 100, TOL = 1e-6;
110  function summarize(text, k = 3, lambda = 0.7) {
111    const sentences = sentTokenize(text)
112      .filter(s => s.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length >= 3);
113    if (!sentences.length) return [];
114    if (sentences.length <= k) return sentences;
115
116    // morphologically normalised TF-IDF
117    const docs = sentences.map(s => normTokens(s, true));
118    const vocab = new Map();
119    for (const d of docs) for (const t of d) if (!vocab.has(t)) vocab.set(t, vocab.size);
120    const n = sentences.length, V = Math.max(vocab.size, 1);
121    const X = docs.map(() => new Float64Array(V));
122    if (vocab.size) {
123      docs.forEach((d, i) => { for (const t of d) X[i][vocab.get(t)] += 1; });
124      for (const row of X) {
125        let s = 0; for (const v of row) s += v;
126        s = Math.max(s, 1e-9);
127        for (let j = 0; j < V; j++) row[j] /= s;
128      }
129      for (let j = 0; j < V; j++) {
130        let df = 0; for (const row of X) if (row[j] > 0) df++;
131        const idf = Math.log((1 + n) / (1 + df)) + 1;
132        for (const row of X) row[j] *= idf;
133      }
134    }
135    // cosine graph
136    const unit = X.map(row => {
137      let s = 0; for (const v of row) s += v * v;
138      const nrm = Math.max(Math.sqrt(s), 1e-9);
139      return row.map(v => v / nrm);
140    });
141    const sim = unit.map((a, i) => unit.map((b, j) => {
142      if (i === j) return 0;
143      let s = 0; for (let t = 0; t < V; t++) s += a[t] * b[t];
144      return Math.max(s, 0);
145    }));
146    // PageRank by power iteration
147    const T = sim.map(row => {
148      const r = row.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
149      return row.map(v => r > 0 ? v / Math.max(r, 1e-9) : 1 / n);
150    });
151    let scores = new Array(n).fill(1 / n), done = false;
152    for (let it = 0; it < MAX_ITER && !done; it++) {
153      const nxt = new Array(n);
154      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
155        let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) s += T[i][j] * scores[i];
156        nxt[j] = (1 - DAMPING) / n + DAMPING * s;
157      }
158      let diff = 0; for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) diff += Math.abs(nxt[j] - scores[j]);
159      scores = nxt;
160      if (diff < TOL) done = true;
161    }
162    // rounded, then stable: exact ties keep document order (see summarize.py)
163    const r12 = x => Math.round(x * 1e12) / 1e12;
164    const order = scores.map((s, i) => [r12(s), i]).sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0]).map(x => x[1]);
165    // MMR
166    const rel = new Map(order.map((idx, pos) => [idx, 1 - pos / Math.max(order.length, 1)]));
167    const selected = [], cand = order.slice();
168    while (cand.length && selected.length < k) {
169      let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
170      for (const idx of cand) {
171        let red = 0;
172        for (const j of selected) red = Math.max(red, sim[idx][j]);
173        const s = r12(lambda * rel.get(idx) - (1 - lambda) * red);
174        if (s > bestScore) { best = idx; bestScore = s; }
175      }
176      selected.push(best);
177      cand.splice(cand.indexOf(best), 1);
178    }
179    return selected.sort((a, b) => a - b).map(i => sentences[i]);
180  }
181
182  /* ============ D / F / G: students (src/lite.py) ============ */
183  const L = DATA.lite;
184  // int8 weights, row-major, base64 (see quantize() in scripts/train_lite.py)
185  function unpack(b64, cols) {
186    const bin = atob(b64), rows = [];
187    for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i += cols) {
188      const row = new Int8Array(cols);
189      for (let j = 0; j < cols; j++) row[j] = (bin.charCodeAt(i + j) << 24) >> 24;
190      rows.push(row);
191    }
192    return rows;
193  }
194  const POLARITY = { Negative: -1, Neutral: 0, Positive: 1 };
195  const softmax = z => {
196    const m = Math.max(...z), e = z.map(v => Math.exp(v - m));
197    const s = e.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
198    return e.map(v => v / s);
199  };
200  const argmax = z => { let b = 0; for (let j = 1; j < z.length; j++) if (z[j] > z[b]) b = j; return b; };
201
202  const T_ = L.topic, topicRow = new Map(), topicIdf = new Map();
203  const topicW = unpack(T_.W, T_.labels.length);
204  T_.terms.forEach((t, i) => { topicRow.set(t, topicW[i]); topicIdf.set(t, T_.idf[i]); });
205  function topic(title, text) {
206    const joined = title ? `${title}. ${text}` : text;
207    const terms = normTokens(joined, true).slice(0, T_.max_tokens);
208    const tf = new Map();
209    for (const t of terms) if (topicRow.has(t)) tf.set(t, (tf.get(t) || 0) + 1);
210    const vec = new Map();
211    for (const [t, c] of tf) vec.set(t, (1 + Math.log(c)) * topicIdf.get(t));
212    let ss = 0; for (const v of vec.values()) ss += v * v;
213    const norm = Math.sqrt(ss) || 1;
214    const k = T_.labels.length, z = new Array(k).fill(0);
215    for (const [t, v] of vec) {
216      const row = topicRow.get(t);
217      for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) z[j] += row[j] * v / norm;
218    }
219    const p = softmax(z.map((v, j) => v * T_.scale + T_.b[j]));
220    const out = {}; T_.labels.forEach((l, j) => { out[l] = p[j]; });
221    return out;
222  }
223
224  const S_ = L.sentiment, sentRow = new Map();
225  const sentW = unpack(S_.W, S_.labels.length);
226  S_.feats.forEach((f, i) => sentRow.set(f, sentW[i]));
227  function sentimentFeatures(sentence) {
228    const toks = tokenize(sentence), feats = [];
229    for (const t of toks) {
230      feats.push("w:" + t);
231      const r = stem(t);
232      if (r !== t) feats.push("r:" + r);
233    }
234    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < toks.length; i++) feats.push("b:" + toks[i] + "_" + toks[i + 1]);
235    return feats;
236  }
237  function sentenceSentiment(sentence) {
238    const feats = [...new Set(sentimentFeatures(sentence))].filter(f => sentRow.has(f)).sort();
239    const k = S_.labels.length, z = new Array(k).fill(0);
240    const inv = feats.length ? 1 / Math.sqrt(feats.length) : 0;
241    for (const f of feats) { const row = sentRow.get(f); for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) z[j] += row[j] * inv; }
242    const p = softmax(z.map((v, j) => v * S_.scale + S_.b[j]));
243    const out = {}; S_.labels.forEach((l, j) => { out[l] = p[j]; });
244    return out;
245  }
246  function documentSentiment(text) {
247    const sents = sentTokenize(text);
248    const dist = { Negative: 0, Neutral: 0, Positive: 0 };
249    if (!sents.length) return { label: "Neutral", polarity: 0, distribution: dist, sentences: [] };
250    const scored = sents.map(s => {
251      const p = sentenceSentiment(s);
252      let label = S_.labels[0];
253      for (const l of S_.labels) if (p[l] > p[label]) label = l;
254      let pol = 0; for (const l of S_.labels) pol += POLARITY[l] * p[l];
255      return { text: s, label, polarity: pol };
256    });
257    let num = 0, den = 0;
258    for (const s of scored) { const w = Math.max(Array.from(s.text).length, 1); num += s.polarity * w; den += w; }
259    const pol = num / den;
260    for (const s of scored) dist[s.label]++;
261    const label = pol > 0.15 ? "Positive" : pol < -0.15 ? "Negative" : "Neutral";
262    return { label, polarity: pol, distribution: dist, sentences: scored };
263  }
264
265  const N_ = L.ner, nerRow = new Map();
266  const nerW = unpack(N_.W, N_.labels.length);
267  N_.feats.forEach((f, i) => nerRow.set(f, nerW[i]));
268  const BOUNDARY = new Set(Array.from(" \t\n\r " + "।,.;:!?\"'()[]{}<>%/\\|-–—"));
269  function words(text) {
270    const out = []; let start = null;
271    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
272      if (BOUNDARY.has(text[i])) { if (start !== null) { out.push([start, i]); start = null; } }
273      else if (start === null) start = i;
274    }
275    if (start !== null) out.push([start, text.length]);
276    return out;
277  }
278  const shape = w => /^[0-9०-९]+$/.test(w) ? "digit" : isAscii(w) ? "latin" : "deva";
279  function nerFeatures(toks, i, prev, prev2) {
280    const w = toks[i], r = stem(w);
281    const p = i > 0 ? toks[i - 1] : "<s>";
282    const n = i + 1 < toks.length ? toks[i + 1] : "</s>";
283    const n2 = i + 2 < toks.length ? toks[i + 2] : "</s>";
284    const f = [
285      "bias", "w:" + w, "r:" + r, "s1:" + w.slice(-1), "s2:" + w.slice(-2), "s3:" + w.slice(-3),
286      "p3:" + w.slice(0, 3), "sh:" + shape(w), "sw:" + (STOP.has(w) ? "True" : "False"),
287      "pw:" + p, "pr:" + stem(p), "nw:" + n, "nr:" + stem(n), "nw2:" + n2,
288      "pl:" + prev, "pl2:" + prev + "|" + prev2, "plw:" + prev + "|" + r,
289      "pwn:" + p + "|" + w, "wn:" + w + "|" + n,
290    ];
291    if (i === 0) f.push("first");
292    return f;
293  }
294  function entitySpans(text) {
295    const offs = words(text), toks = offs.map(([s, e]) => text.slice(s, e));
296    const k = N_.labels.length, spans = [];
297    let prev = "O", prev2 = "O";
298    for (let i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) {
299      const z = N_.b.slice();
300      for (const f of nerFeatures(toks, i, prev, prev2)) {
301        const row = nerRow.get(f);
302        if (row) for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) z[j] += row[j] * N_.scale;
303      }
304      const lab = N_.labels[argmax(z)];
305      if (lab !== "O") {
306        const [s, e] = offs[i], last = spans[spans.length - 1];
307        if (last && last[2] === lab && s - last[1] <= 1) last[1] = e;
308        else spans.push([s, e, lab]);
309      }
310      prev2 = prev; prev = lab;
311    }
312    return spans;
313  }
314  function groupEntities(text, spans) {
315    const counts = new Map(), surfaces = new Map();
316    for (const [s, e, lab] of spans) {
317      const surf = text.slice(s, e).trim(); if (!surf) continue;
318      const parts = surf.split(/\s+/);
319      const canon = [...parts.slice(0, -1), stem(parts[parts.length - 1])].join(" ");
320      const key = lab + "␀" + canon;
321      counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) || 0) + 1);
322      if (!surfaces.has(key)) surfaces.set(key, new Map());
323      const m = surfaces.get(key); m.set(surf, (m.get(surf) || 0) + 1);
324    }
325    const mostCommon = m => [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);  // stable
326    const out = {};
327    for (const [key] of mostCommon(counts)) {
328      const lab = key.split("␀")[0];
329      (out[lab] = out[lab] || []).push(mostCommon(surfaces.get(key))[0][0]);
330    }
331    return out;
332  }
333
334  /* ============ the lite pipeline (mirrors src/pipeline.process) ============ */
335  function pipeline(title, text) {
336    title = (title || "").trim(); text = (text || "").trim();
337    const topicScores = topic(title, text);
338    const summarySents = summarize(text, 3);
339    const summary = summarySents.join(" ");
340    const entSource = `${title}. ${summary}`.trim();
341    const entities = groupEntities(entSource, entitySpans(entSource));
342    const sent = documentSentiment(summary || text);
343    const toks = tokenize(text);
344    const inflected = toks.filter(t => analyse(t).stripped.length > 0).length;
345    return {
346      title, topic_scores: topicScores, summary, summary_sentences: summarySents,
347      entities, sentiment: sent.label, polarity: sent.polarity,
348      sentiment_distribution: sent.distribution, sentence_sentiment: sent.sentences,
349      tokens: toks.length, inflected_ratio: toks.length ? inflected / toks.length : 0,
350    };
351  }
352
353  return { analyse, stem, tokenize, normTokens, sentTokenize, buildIndex, search,
354           summarize, topic, sentenceSentiment, documentSentiment, entitySpans,
355           groupEntities, pipeline };
356}
357
358if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports) module.exports = { makeEngine };

The demo page's layout and interface code.

6<title>Marathi News Intelligence</title>

8<style>
9  /* Light, single-theme palette. Every colour is declared here. */
10  :root{
11    --bg:#f6f9fa; --card:#ffffff; --soft:#eef4f5; --line:#dde7ea;
12    --ink:#1e3238; --ink-soft:#5b757d; --ink-mute:#8ca3a9;
13    --accent:#1f7d7d; --accent-soft:#e2f2f1;
14    --pos:#37785a; --pos-bg:#e6f3ec;
15    --neg:#a85341; --neg-bg:#fbeae6;
16    --neu:#7d9299; --neu-bg:#eef2f3;
17    --mono:"IBM Plex Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
18    --deva:"Tiro Devanagari Marathi","Nirmala UI","Noto Sans Devanagari",serif;
19    --sans:"DM Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,sans-serif;
20    --r:10px;
21  }
22  *{box-sizing:border-box}
23  body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);
24       font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
25  .deva{font-family:var(--deva);line-height:1.9}
26  .wrap{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding-inline:20px}
27
28  /* header */
29  .head{padding-block:30px 20px}

31  .title .mr{font-family:var(--deva);color:var(--accent);font-size:1.5rem}

33  .title .meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--ink-mute);
34    margin-left:auto;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}

36
37  /* tabs */
38  .tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
39    padding-bottom:0;margin-top:22px}
40  .tab{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.92rem;font-weight:500;border:none;
41    background:none;color:var(--ink-mute);padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer;
42    border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px}
43  .tab:hover{color:var(--accent)}
44  .tab[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--accent);border-bottom-color:var(--accent);
45    font-weight:700}
46  .tab .n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;opacity:.65;margin-right:5px}
47
48  .panelwrap{padding-block:26px 60px}
49  .lead{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.95rem;margin:0 0 18px;max-width:66ch}
50
51  .card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);
52    padding:20px}
53
54  label.fl{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;
55    text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink-mute);
56    margin-bottom:7px}
57  input[type=text]{font-family:var(--deva);font-size:1.25rem;width:100%;
58    padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;
59    background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
60  input[type=text]:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px;
61    border-color:transparent}
62  select{font-family:var(--deva);font-size:1rem;width:100%;padding:11px 13px;
63    border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--card);
64    color:var(--ink)}
65  select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
66  .chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:11px}
67  .chip{font-family:var(--deva);font-size:.95rem;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:999px;
68    border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink-soft);
69    cursor:pointer}
70  .chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
71  .chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
72
73  /* gloss */
74  .gloss{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;
75    margin-top:24px;min-height:78px}
76  .mb{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px}
77  .mb .seg{font-family:var(--deva);font-size:1.5rem;padding:8px 15px;border-radius:9px;
78    border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--soft);line-height:1.5}
79  .mb.root .seg{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent);
80    font-weight:500}
81  .mb .feat{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.63rem;letter-spacing:.06em;
82    color:var(--ink-mute);text-transform:uppercase}
83  .plus{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--ink-mute);font-size:1.2rem;padding-bottom:24px}
84  .note{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:20px;padding-top:15px;
85    border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
86  .note b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
87
88  .fams{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));
89    gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
90  .fam{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 13px;
91    background:var(--card)}
92  .fam .f{font-family:var(--deva);font-size:.95rem;line-height:2;color:var(--ink-soft)}
93  .fam .r{font-family:var(--deva);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--accent);font-weight:500;
94    margin-top:4px}
95  .fam .r::before{content:"→ ";font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--ink-mute);
96    font-size:.85rem}
97
98  /* search */
99  .vs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:20px}
100  @media(max-width:680px){.vs{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
101  .side{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;
102    background:var(--card)}
103  .side-h{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;
104    align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
105  .side-h .nm{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;
106    letter-spacing:.09em}
107  .side.a .side-h{background:var(--neg-bg);color:var(--neg)}
108  .side.b .side-h{background:var(--pos-bg);color:var(--pos)}
109  .cnt{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;
110    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
111  .side-b{max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto}
112  .res{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
113  .res:last-child{border-bottom:none}
114  .res .t{font-family:var(--deva);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.7;display:block}
115  .res .m{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.63rem;color:var(--ink-mute);margin-top:3px;
116    text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;display:block}
117  .none{padding:34px 14px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink-mute);font-size:.88rem}
118  .none b{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--neg);
119    margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:500}
120
121  /* pipeline */
122  .stage{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;margin-top:11px;
123    background:var(--card);overflow:hidden}
124  .stage-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 14px;
125    background:var(--soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
126  .bdg{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.66rem;font-weight:500;width:20px;height:20px;
127    display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:5px;background:var(--accent);
128    color:#fff;flex:none}
129  .stage-n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;
130    letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink-soft)}
131  .stage-b{padding:15px 14px}
132  .kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:.9rem;
133    align-items:baseline}
134  .kv .v{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-mute);
135    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
136  .bar{height:6px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;
137    margin-top:5px}
138  .bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent)}
139  .lab{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.63rem;text-transform:uppercase;
140    letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink-mute);margin-bottom:5px}
141  .ents{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:11px}
142  .ent{font-family:var(--deva);font-size:.92rem;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:6px;
143    background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)}
144  .tone{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;
145    text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px}
146  .tone.Positive{background:var(--pos-bg);color:var(--pos)}
147  .tone.Negative{background:var(--neg-bg);color:var(--neg)}
148  .tone.Neutral{background:var(--neu-bg);color:var(--neu)}
149  .stack{display:flex;height:14px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:12px}
150  .stack i{display:block;height:100%}
151  .en{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink-soft);border-left:2px solid var(--accent);
152    padding-left:12px;margin-top:10px}
153  footer{padding-block:0 40px;color:var(--ink-mute);font-size:.8rem}
154  @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}
155  /* ---- pasted-text additions ---- */
156  textarea{font-family:var(--deva);font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.8;width:100%;
157    padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;
158    background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);resize:vertical}
159  textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px;border-color:transparent}
160  #mword{font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.6}
161  .fld{margin-top:14px}
162  .fld:first-child{margin-top:0}
163  .actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
164  .btn{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;padding:8px 16px;
165    border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);
166    color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
167  .btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
168  .btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
169  .btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);color:#fff}
170  .btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default}
171  .status{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
172  .status.err{color:var(--neg)}
173  .mode{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-family:var(--mono);
174    font-size:.66rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:3px 10px;
175    border-radius:99px;background:var(--neu-bg);color:var(--ink-soft)}
176  .mode.full{background:var(--pos-bg);color:var(--pos)}
177  .mode::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
178  .src{margin-left:auto;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.06em;
179    text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-mute)}
180  .cmp{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-mute);margin-top:10px}
181  .mtable{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:16px;font-size:.9rem}
182  .mtable th{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;text-transform:uppercase;
183    letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink-mute);text-align:left;font-weight:500;
184    padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
185  .mtable td{padding:5px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
186  .mtable td.d{font-family:var(--deva)}
187  .mtable td.r{font-family:var(--deva);color:var(--accent);font-weight:500}
188  .mtable td.f{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;color:var(--ink-mute)}
189  .mtable td .cmp{font-family:var(--sans);margin:0}
190  .tblwrap{max-height:360px;overflow:auto}
191  .stats{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
192  .stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--accent)}
193  .stat span{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-mute)}
194  details.add{margin-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px}
195  details.add summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--accent);font-weight:500}
196  .mine{color:var(--accent)}
197  .sentl{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:12px 0 0}
198  .sentl li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;padding:5px 0;
199    border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-family:var(--deva);font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.7}
200  .sentl .tone{flex:none}
201  code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85em;background:var(--soft);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px}
202</style>
203</head>
204<body>
205
206<script id="payload" type="application/json">__DATA__</script>
207
208<div class="wrap head">
209  <div class="title">
210    <span class="mr">मराठी</span>
211    <h1>News Intelligence</h1>
212    <span class="meta" id="meta"></span>
213  </div>
214  <p>Paste any Marathi news text &mdash; category, summary, entities, sentiment,
215     English translation and search come out.</p>
216
217  <div class="tabs" role="tablist">
218    <button class="tab" role="tab" id="t0" aria-controls="p0" aria-selected="true"><span class="n">I</span>Morphology</button>
219    <button class="tab" role="tab" id="t1" aria-controls="p1" aria-selected="false"><span class="n">C</span>Search</button>
220    <button class="tab" role="tab" id="t2" aria-controls="p2" aria-selected="false"><span class="n">D E F G A</span>Full pipeline</button>
221  </div>
222</div>
223
224<div class="wrap panelwrap">
225
226  <div id="p0" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="t0">
227    <p class="lead">Marathi joins a whole phrase into one word. Type a word, or paste
228      a whole sentence or article &mdash; the analyser strips each word's suffix chain
229      back to its root, live.</p>
230    <div class="card">
231      <label class="fl" for="mword">Marathi word or text</label>
232      <textarea id="mword" rows="2" spellcheck="false">घरांमधून</textarea>
233      <div class="chips" id="mchips"></div>
234      <div id="mout"></div>
235    </div>
236    <div class="fams" id="fams"></div>
237  </div>
238
239  <div id="p1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="t1" hidden>
240    <p class="lead">Two real search indexes over the same <span id="ndocs">400</span>
241      articles, built in your browser. The only difference is whether words pass
242      through the analyser first. Type or paste any query.</p>
243    <div class="card">
244      <label class="fl" for="q">Search query</label>
245      <input type="text" id="q" value="न्यायालय" spellcheck="false">
246      <div class="chips" id="qchips"></div>
247      <div class="vs">
248        <div class="side a">
249          <div class="side-h"><span class="nm">Without morphology</span><span class="cnt" id="c-a">0</span></div>
250          <div class="side-b" id="r-a"></div>
251        </div>
252        <div class="side b">
253          <div class="side-h"><span class="nm">With morphology</span><span class="cnt" id="c-b">0</span></div>
254          <div class="side-b" id="r-b"></div>
255        </div>
256      </div>
257      <div class="note" id="qnote"></div>
258      <details class="add">
259        <summary>Add your own articles to the index</summary>
260        <div class="fld"><label class="fl" for="atitle">Headline</label>
261          <input type="text" id="atitle" spellcheck="false"></div>
262        <div class="fld"><label class="fl" for="atext">Marathi article text</label>
263          <textarea id="atext" rows="5" spellcheck="false"></textarea></div>
264        <div class="actions"><button class="btn primary" type="button" id="aadd">Add to both indexes</button>
265          <span class="status" id="astatus"></span></div>
266      </details>
267    </div>
268  </div>
269
270  <div id="p2" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="t2" hidden>
271    <p class="lead">Paste any Marathi article, or start from an example, then press
272      <b>Analyse</b>. It runs in your browser; if the local model server is running
273      (<code>python app/server.py</code>) it uses the full models instead.</p>
274    <div class="card">
275      <div class="fld"><label class="fl" for="pick">Start from an example</label>
276        <select id="pick"></select></div>
277      <div class="fld"><label class="fl" for="ptitle">Headline (optional)</label>
278        <input type="text" id="ptitle" spellcheck="false"></div>
279      <div class="fld"><label class="fl" for="ptext">Marathi article text</label>
280        <textarea id="ptext" rows="8" spellcheck="false"></textarea></div>
281      <div class="actions">
282        <button class="btn primary" type="button" id="run">Analyse</button>
283        <button class="btn" type="button" id="clear">Clear</button>
284        <span class="mode" id="mode">In-browser models</span>
285        <span class="status" id="runnote"></span>
286      </div>
287    </div>
288    <div id="artview"></div>
289  </div>
290
291</div>
292
293<footer class="wrap">Data: XL-Sum Marathi (BBC Marathi). Models: L3Cube-MahaNLP, NLLB-200.
294  In-browser models are small students trained to imitate the full models; run
295  <code>python app/server.py</code> to analyse with the full models.</footer>
296
297<script>
298/*__ENGINE__*/
299</script>
300<script>
301(function(){
302  "use strict";
303  const DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("payload").textContent);
304  const E = makeEngine(DATA);
305  const AG = DATA.lite.agreement;
306  const SERVER = "http://127.0.0.1:8765";
307  const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
308  const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","\"":"&quot;"}[c]));
309  const pct = v => (v*100).toFixed(1) + "%";
310  const hasDeva = t => /[ऀ-ॿ]/.test(t || "");
311
312  /* ---- tabs ---- */
313  const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll(".tab")];
314  tabs.forEach(t => t.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
315    tabs.forEach(o=>{
316      const on = o === t;
317      o.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on));
318      document.getElementById(o.getAttribute("aria-controls")).hidden = !on;
319    });
320  }));
321  $("#meta").textContent = DATA.meta.corpus_size.toLocaleString() + " articles processed";
322
323  /* ================= tab 1: morphology ================= */
324  const WORDS = ["घरांमधून","शाळेतून","न्यायालयाने","मुलांना","पुण्यातील","विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी","जिंकले","मुंबईपासून"];
325  $("#mchips").innerHTML = WORDS.map(w=>`<button class="chip" type="button" data-w="${esc(w)}">${esc(w)}</button>`).join("");
326
327  function gloss(word){
328    const a = E.analyse(word);
329    const segs=[`<div class="mb root"><span class="seg">${esc(a.root)}</span><span class="feat">root</span></div>`];
330    for(let i=a.stripped.length-1;i>=0;i--){
331      segs.push(`<span class="plus">+</span>`);
332      segs.push(`<div class="mb"><span class="seg">${esc(a.stripped[i])}</span><span class="feat">${esc(a.features[i])}</span></div>`);
333    }
334    const note = a.stripped.length
335      ? `Every form of this word now indexes under one term: <b>${esc(a.root)}</b>.`
336      : `<b>${esc(word)}</b> carries no suffix &mdash; it is already a root.`;
337    return `<div class="gloss">${segs.join("")}</div><div class="note">${note}</div>`;
338  }
339  function textAnalysis(toks){
340    const seen = new Map();
341    for(const t of toks) seen.set(t,(seen.get(t)||0)+1);
342    const rows = [...seen.keys()].map(w=>[w,E.analyse(w)]);
343    const inflected = toks.filter(t=>E.analyse(t).stripped.length).length;
344    const roots = new Set(rows.map(([,a])=>a.root));
345    const shown = rows.slice(0,300);
346    return `<div class="stats">
347        <div class="stat"><b>${toks.length}</b><span>words</span></div>
348        <div class="stat"><b>${pct(inflected/toks.length)}</b><span>carry a suffix</span></div>
349        <div class="stat"><b>${seen.size} → ${roots.size}</b><span>distinct forms → roots</span></div>
350      </div>
351      <div class="tblwrap"><table class="mtable">
352        <thead><tr><th>Word</th><th>Root</th><th>Suffixes stripped</th><th>Grammar</th></tr></thead>
353        <tbody>${shown.map(([w,a])=>`<tr><td class="d">${esc(w)}</td><td class="r">${esc(a.root)}</td>
354          <td class="d">${a.stripped.length?a.stripped.slice().reverse().map(esc).join(" + ")
355            :a.root===w?"&mdash;":`<span class="cmp">${Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(DATA.morph.exceptions,w)?"exception list":"final vowel normalised"}</span>`}</td>
356          <td class="f">${a.features.length?a.features.slice().reverse().map(esc).join(" + "):""}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>
357      </table></div>
358      ${rows.length>shown.length?`<div class="cmp">Showing the first ${shown.length} of ${rows.length} distinct words.</div>`:""}`;
359  }
360  function renderMorph(text){
361    text = (text||"").trim();
362    const toks = E.tokenize(text).filter(hasDeva);
363    let html;
364    if(!text) html = `<div class="note">Type a Marathi word, or paste some Marathi text.</div>`;
365    else if(!toks.length) html = `<div class="note">No Marathi (Devanagari) words found in that text.</div>`;
366    else if(toks.length===1) html = gloss(toks[0]);
367    else html = textAnalysis(toks);
368    $("#mout").innerHTML = html;
369    document.querySelectorAll("#mchips .chip").forEach(c=>
370      c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(c.dataset.w===text)));
371  }
372  $("#mword").addEventListener("input", e=>renderMorph(e.target.value));
373  $("#mchips").addEventListener("click", e=>{
374    const b=e.target.closest(".chip"); if(!b) return;
375    $("#mword").value=b.dataset.w; renderMorph(b.dataset.w);
376  });
377  renderMorph($("#mword").value);
378
379  const FAMS = [["घर","घरात","घरातून","घरांमधून"],["शाळा","शाळेत","शाळेतून","शाळांना"],
380                ["मुंबई","मुंबईत","मुंबईतील","मुंबईपासून"]];
381  $("#fams").innerHTML = FAMS.map(g=>{
382    const r=[...new Set(g.map(E.stem))];
383    return `<div class="fam"><div class="f">${g.map(esc).join("&nbsp;·&nbsp;")}</div>
384      <div class="r">${r.map(esc).join(" / ")}</div></div>`;
385  }).join("");
386
387  /* ================= tab 2: search ================= */
388  const DOCS = DATA.docs.slice();
389  let iA, iB;
390  function reindex(){
391    const texts = DOCS.map(d=>`${d.title} ${d.summary}`);
392    iA = E.buildIndex(texts,false); iB = E.buildIndex(texts,true);
393    $("#ndocs").textContent = DOCS.length.toLocaleString();
394  }
395  reindex();
396
397  const QS = ["न्यायालय","सरकार","महिला","शाळा","पोलीस","पाऊस"];
398  $("#qchips").innerHTML = QS.map(q=>`<button class="chip" type="button" data-q="${esc(q)}">${esc(q)}</button>`).join("");
399
400  function side(elId,cntId,hits){
401    $(cntId).textContent = hits.length;
402    $(elId).innerHTML = hits.length
403      ? hits.slice(0,10).map(([i,s])=>{
404          const d=DOCS[i];
405          return `<div class="res"><span class="t">${esc(d.title)}</span>
406            <span class="m">${d.mine?'<span class="mine">your article</span> · ':""}${esc(d.topic)} · score ${s.toFixed(2)}</span></div>`;
407        }).join("")
408      : `<div class="none"><b>0</b>No documents matched.</div>`;
409  }
410  function runSearch(q){

465  /* ================= in-browser translation (NLLB-200) ================= */
466  // The worker holds no static import, so it always starts; it then fetches
467  // transformers.js from the first CDN that answers. Some networks (several
468  // Indian mobile carriers, for one) block cdn.jsdelivr.net outright, so the
469  // same file is tried on unpkg and on jsDelivr's alternate hostnames, and the
470  // ONNX runtime's WebAssembly is loaded from whichever CDN worked -- by
471  // default transformers.js would fetch it from cdn.jsdelivr.net regardless.
472  const WORKER_SRC = `
473    const PKG = "@huggingface/transformers@3.8.1/dist/";
474    const CDNS = ["https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/", "https://unpkg.com/",
475                  "https://fastly.jsdelivr.net/npm/", "https://gcore.jsdelivr.net/npm/"];
476    const MODEL = "Xenova/nllb-200-distilled-600M";
477    let lib = null, tr = null;
478
479    const withTimeout = (p, ms) => Promise.race([p,
480      new Promise((_, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error("timed out")), ms))]);
481
482    async function loadLibrary() {
483      const tried = [];
484      for (const cdn of CDNS) {
485        const base = cdn + PKG, host = new URL(cdn).host;
486        self.postMessage({ type: "status", text: "Loading the translation program from " + host + "…" });
487        try {
488          const m = await withTimeout(import(base + "transformers.min.js"), 20000);
489          m.env.allowLocalModels = false;
490          m.env.backends.onnx.wasm.wasmPaths = base;
491          return m;
492        } catch (err) { tried.push(host); }
493      }
494      const e = new Error("Could not load the translation program — this network blocks " +
495        tried.join(", ") + ". Try another network (e.g. Wi-Fi), or use “Show saved translation” " +
496        "for the examples, or run python app/server.py.");
497      e.stage = "program";
498      throw e;
499    }
500
501    self.onmessage = async (e) => {
502      const { texts } = e.data;
503      try {
504        if (!lib) lib = await loadLibrary();
505        if (!tr) {
506          const files = {};
507          try {
508            tr = await lib.pipeline("translation", MODEL, {
509              dtype: "q8",
510              progress_callback: (p) => {
511                if (p.status === "progress" && p.total) {
512                  files[p.file] = [p.loaded, p.total];
513                  let l = 0, t = 0;
514                  for (const [a, b] of Object.values(files)) { l += a; t += b; }
515                  self.postMessage({ type: "download", loaded: l, total: t });
516                }
517              },
518            });
519          } catch (err) {
520            const m = new Error("Could not download the translation model from huggingface.co (" +
521              String((err && err.message) || err) + "). Check the connection and try again, or run " +
522              "python app/server.py.");
523            m.stage = "model";
524            throw m;
525          }
526        }
527        const out = [];
528        for (let i = 0; i < texts.length; i++) {
529          self.postMessage({ type: "step", i, n: texts.length });
530          const r = await tr(texts[i], { src_lang: "mar_Deva", tgt_lang: "eng_Latn", max_new_tokens: 256 });
531          out.push(r[0].translation_text);
532        }
533        self.postMessage({ type: "done", out });
534      } catch (err) {
535        self.postMessage({ type: "error", stage: err.stage || "translate",
536                           message: String((err && err.message) || err) });
537      }
538    };`;
539  let worker = null;
540  function browserTranslate(texts, onStatus){
541    return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
542      if(!worker){
543        const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([WORKER_SRC], {type:"text/javascript"}));
544        worker = new Worker(url, {type:"module"});
545      }
546      worker.onmessage = e=>{
547        const m = e.data;
548        if(m.type==="status") onStatus(m.text);
549        else if(m.type==="download") onStatus(`Downloading the translation model (once, then cached): ${(m.loaded/1e6).toFixed(0)} / ${(m.total/1e6).toFixed(0)} MB`);
550        else if(m.type==="step") onStatus(`Translating sentence ${m.i+1} of ${m.n}…`);
551        else if(m.type==="done") resolve(m.out);
552        else if(m.type==="error") reject(new Error(m.message));
553      };
554      worker.onerror = e=>{ worker = null;
555        reject(new Error("The browser could not start the translator (" + (e.message || "worker error") +
556          "). Try Chrome or Edge, or run python app/server.py.")); };
557      worker.postMessage({texts});
558    });
559  }

657  async function translate(btn){
658    const d = current.result, st = $("#trstatus");
659    const set = (t, err) => { if(st){ st.textContent = t; st.classList.toggle("err", !!err); } };
660    const sents = E.sentTokenize(d.summary).slice(0,12);
661    const texts = [...(d.title?[d.title]:[]), ...sents];
662    if(!texts.length){ set("Nothing to translate yet.", true); return; }
663    btn.disabled = true;
664    try{
665      let out, source;
666      if(await detectServer()){
667        set("Translating on the local server…");
668        out = (await post("/api/translate", {texts})).translations;
669        source = "NLLB-200 on the local server.";
670      } else {
671        set("Loading the translation model…");
672        out = await browserTranslate(texts, set);
673        source = "NLLB-200, run in your browser.";
674      }
675      if(current.result !== d) return;
676      d.title_en = d.title ? out[0] : "";
677      d.summary_en = (d.title ? out.slice(1) : out).join(" ");
678      d.translation_source = source;
679      render();
680    }catch(err){
681      btn.disabled = false;
682      set("Translation failed: " + err.message, true);
683    }
684  }
685
686  async function analyse(){
687    const title = $("#ptitle").value.trim(), text = $("#ptext").value.trim();
688    const note = $("#runnote");
689    note.classList.remove("err");
690    if(!text){ note.textContent = "Paste some Marathi article text first."; note.classList.add("err"); return; }
691    if(!hasDeva(text)){ note.textContent = "That doesn't look like Marathi (Devanagari) text."; note.classList.add("err"); return; }
692    const exIdx = $("#pick").value;
693    const ex = exIdx !== "" && SHOW[+exIdx].text === text && SHOW[+exIdx].title === title ? SHOW[+exIdx] : null;
694    $("#run").disabled = true;
695    let result, mode = "lite";
696    try{
697      if(await detectServer()){
698        note.textContent = "Running the full models on the local server…";
699        try{
700          const r = await post("/api/analyse", {title, text, translate:false});
701          result = {title, topic_scores:r.topic_scores, summary:r.summary, entities:r.entities,
702            sentiment:r.sentiment, polarity:r.polarity, sentiment_distribution:r.sentiment_distribution,
703            tokens:r.tokens, inflected_ratio:r.inflected_ratio};
704          mode = "full";
705        }catch(err){
706          note.textContent = "Local server failed (" + err.message + "); used the in-browser models.";
707        }
708      }
709      if(!result){
710        result = E.pipeline(title, text);
711        if(mode === "lite" && !note.textContent.startsWith("Local server")) note.textContent = "";
712      } else note.textContent = "";
713      current = {result, mode, example: ex};
714      render();
715    } finally {
716      $("#run").disabled = false;
717    }
718  }
719

723    analyse();
724  }

107    def test_morphology_finds_what_plain_tokens_miss(self):
108        """
109        The corpus says शाळांमध्ये and शाळेत; the query says शाळा. A plain
110        index cannot match either, a normalised one matches both.
111        """
112        plain = BM25Index(use_morph=False).build(DOCS)
113        morph = BM25Index(use_morph=True).build(DOCS)
114        assert len(plain.search("शाळा", top_k=5)) == 0
115        assert len(morph.search("शाळा", top_k=5)) == 2
116
117    def test_morphology_shrinks_the_vocabulary(self):
118        plain = BM25Index(use_morph=False).build(DOCS)
119        morph = BM25Index(use_morph=True).build(DOCS)
120        assert len(morph.postings) < len(plain.postings)
121
122    def test_hits_are_rank_ordered(self):
123        idx = BM25Index().build(DOCS)
124        hits = idx.search("नवीन", top_k=5)
125        assert [h.rank for h in hits] == list(range(len(hits)))
126        assert all(a.score >= b.score for a, b in zip(hits, hits[1:]))
127
128    def test_empty_query_and_empty_index(self):
129        assert BM25Index().build(DOCS).search("", top_k=5) == []
130        assert BM25Index().build([]).search("शाळा", top_k=5) == []
131
132    def test_unknown_term_returns_nothing(self):
133        assert BM25Index().build(DOCS).search("झेब्रा", top_k=5) == []
134
135    def test_rrf_prefers_documents_both_runs_agree_on(self):
136        run_a = [Hit(doc_id=1, score=9.0, rank=0), Hit(doc_id=2, score=8.0, rank=1)]
137        run_b = [Hit(doc_id=2, score=0.9, rank=0), Hit(doc_id=3, score=0.8, rank=1)]
138        fused = reciprocal_rank_fusion([run_a, run_b], top_k=3)
139        assert fused[0].doc_id == 2          # only doc ranked highly by both
140
141    def test_bm25_index_round_trips(self, tmp_path):
142        idx = BM25Index().build(DOCS)
143        p = tmp_path / "idx.pkl"
144        idx.save(p)
145        assert BM25Index.load(p).search("शाळा", 5) == idx.search("शाळा", 5)

185        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "scripts"))
186        import evaluate

189    def test_identical_text_scores_one(self):

191        assert r["rouge1"] == pytest.approx(1.0)
192        assert r["rougeL"] == pytest.approx(1.0)

197    def test_morphology_credits_inflectional_variants(self):
198        """
199        Same content, different case endings: raw ROUGE-1 misses it, the
200        normalised variant catches it. This is why the evaluation reports both.
201        """
202        pred, gold = "शाळेत विद्यार्थी", "शाळांमध्ये विद्यार्थ्यांना"
203        assert self.ev.rouge_all(pred, gold, False)["rouge1"] == 0.0
204        assert self.ev.rouge_all(pred, gold, True)["rouge1"] > 0.0
205
206    def test_empty_inputs_do_not_crash(self):
207        assert self.ev.rouge_all("", "काहीतरी", False)["rouge1"] == 0.0

292class TestSummaryTies:
293    def test_exact_ties_keep_document_order(self):
294        """Repeated sentences tie exactly; the earlier one must win, so the
295        page's JavaScript port (different float rounding) agrees."""
296        from src.summarize import summarize
297        s = "हा पहिला वेगळा मुद्दा आहे."
298        dup = "सरकारने नवीन योजना जाहीर केली आहे."
299        text = " ".join([dup, s, "आणखी एक वेगळे वाक्य आहे.", dup, "शेवटचे वेगळे वाक्य आहे."])
300        # The two copies (indices 0 and 3) have identical PageRank scores.
301        for k in (1, 2, 3):
302            idx = summarize(text, k=k).indices
303            assert not (3 in idx and 0 not in idx)

307class TestServer:
308    def test_health_and_cors_preflight(self):
309        import json as _json
310        import threading
311        import urllib.request
312        from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
313        from app.server import Handler
314
315        srv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
316        threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
317        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_address[1]}"
318        try:
319            with urllib.request.urlopen(base + "/api/health") as r:
320                assert _json.loads(r.read())["ok"] is True
321                assert r.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] == "*"
322            req = urllib.request.Request(base + "/api/analyse", method="OPTIONS")
323            with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
324                assert r.status == 204
325                assert r.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network"] == "true"
326            req = urllib.request.Request(base + "/api/analyse", data=b'{"text": "  "}',
327                                         method="POST",
328                                         headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
329            try:
330                urllib.request.urlopen(req)
331                raise AssertionError("empty text should be rejected")
332            except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
333                assert err.code == 400
334        finally:
335            srv.shutdown()
336
